title: TP THE END
features:
[+] Instant End Warp – Provides a one-click manual teleport that sends your character directly to the final tower coordinates.

[+] Automated TP Loop – Features an intelligent background system that constantly monitors your position and warps you back to the end if you fall or move away.

[+] Smart Respawn Anchor – Automatically detects when your character respawns and teleports you back to the goal instantly, bypassing the entire climb.

[+] Proximity Detection – Includes built-in distance logic that only triggers the teleport when necessary, ensuring smooth and stable movement.

[+] Real-Time Success Alerts – Integrated notification system that confirms every successful teleport with a visual pop-up on your screen.

[+] Persistent Session Guard – Uses specialized listeners to ensure the teleport logic stays active even after character resets or round changes.
